tbesh_html:
Zoheleth = "serpent"
a boundary stone near Jerusalem where Adonijah slew sheep and oxen
Another name of en ro.gel (עֵין רֹגֵל "En-rogel" H5883)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Zocheleth, a boundary stone in. Palestine
strongs_1890.derivation: feminine active participle of H2119 (זָחַל); crawling (i.e. serpent);
